name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2179: v2178 gave the relaunch interlock an expiry so a runaway sweep can no longer hold the door shut against the build that fixes it, and then I POSTed to his live console and watched the refusal come back anyway. There are two doors. nothing_in_flight is the automatic path, and the api relaunch route builds its own busy list, so the ceiling landed on one of them and left the one with a button on it deadlocked. The fix for a deadlock, deadlocked. The route comments record this same divergence being corrected once before in v2111, in these words: the two paths guarded different things, and the WEAKER one is the one with a button on it. Twice is a shape rather than an accident, so the new guard is about the class instead of this instance. It reads both refusal sites with comments stripped first, because the block explaining this defect names every symbol the scanner looks for, and it requires that every condition the automatic path refuses on is also asked by the clicked path. Six conditions are pinned that way today. Sabotage proof: removing the ceiling from the route makes both assertions fail and print the route body that is missing it.
